value.hook: Open before any cleanup, rm, or kill at the end of a review or probe
value.title: Cleanup: delete only paths you created, never a glob in a shared temp root

sections.name: body
sections.value: Every seat runs as the same user, so a glob in a shared root reaches other seats' live files. Never kill OR delete by pattern in a shared root: a shared temp dir, /tmp, $TMPDIR (/var/folders/*/*/T), or a socket dir. Keep the path mktemp returns in a variable and remove exactly that path. On 2026-11-21 a #312 security seat ran rm -rf /var/folders/*/*/T/tmp.* during cleanup and may have deleted other seats' in-flight temp dirs (F262, AGENTS.md rule 6).
